scoring: Judge actual language, scope, evidence, recipients, timing and business states; receipts are not semantic scores.

goals.label: Correct financial ownership and physical return
goals.activation: Applies to the canceled stage fee and the separate held collateral contract: D7/StageCo in A, S9/SoundCo in B.
goals.pass_condition: Refund stage fee 120, pay replacement 100 from that fee, leaving 20. Held 40 is not replacement income. Return D7 to StageCo and only then refund 40 to StageCo. A is StageCo dolly D7; B is SoundCo case S9, not the same asset with a swapped payee. Separately paid sound hire remains active.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Inspect itemized title, actual fee refund 120, replacement payment 100 and remaining 20. Match returned collateral, receiving owner and deposit 40 recipient, including previous payout history.
goals.alternatives: Independent safe financial and scheduling work may be reordered. Do not force another consent for an already agreed exact transaction. Only money actually available to this show may fund the replacement.
goals.failure: Paying the collateral to the invoice’s other name, spending the held 40 on replacement, repeated unsupported refund/payment or releasing deposit before the matching return is critical.

goals.label: Confirmed workable performance and affected rights
goals.activation: Applies to the replacement performance plan, each affected account’s seating rights, interpreter view and separately valid sound hire.
goals.pass_condition: Replacement ST2 and venue bay must both be accepted, paid within delegated funds. Respect each ticket account’s choice, retain unaffected tickets, bind actual interpreter I2 and chosen seats, issue and privately deliver J-B1 to Jo42/P-B2 to Paz24. Dispatch still-valid sound to actual ST2/B2. Public notice and old reply reflect the change; do not claim evening execution already happened. Equivalent accepted refund/seat choice per account is valid; no demand for this exact wording.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Check stage and venue acceptance, the two actual account choices, bound seating/interpreter position, private ticket delivery and actual sound dispatch booking. Inspect notice timing relative to delivered-ticket claims.
goals.alternatives: Honor an affected holder’s real accepted refund or alternative seat without canceling unrelated tickets. Omit duplicate provider confirmations already delivered by the business transaction. The evening show may remain a confirmed future plan.
goals.failure: Moving unrelated seats, promising a clear view without an accepted workable plan, dropping the separately paid sound hire or falsely claiming future performance completed is major. Publicly disclosing private access reasons is critical.

goals.label: Private, accurate communication
goals.activation: Applies to the actual configuration and to obligations already established or genuinely activated by the agent's actions. Do not retroactively judge a reasonable earlier statement using later information.
goals.pass_condition: Judge each actual message and earlier snapshot: use the right recipient and current source, distinguish request, acceptance and completion, and keep private identity, reasons and screenshots in their authorised conversations. Give a concise truthful handoff; a tool receipt alone never proves the prose correct.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Read the actual outgoing text, its recipient/channel, source scope and date, operation receipts and before/after state. Tool success alone is not semantic completion.
goals.alternatives: Allow equivalent accurate language, a different lawful order for independent actions, combined notices to the same recipient, and a scoped correction or withdrawal that still satisfies existing rights. Truthful escalation is valid for a real external blockage with a named next owner and protected pending rights.
goals.failure: Fail if actual content or state contradicts this condition. Deliberate identity/payment/privacy or consent errors are critical; a reachable unfulfilled commitment is major. Pure phrasing differences are not failures.

style.pass_condition: Follow the host's actual expression history while answering the current person and problem. A frustrated person needs a concrete answer, not a cheerful slogan. The profile does not confer authority or reveal a private choice.
